originalTitle: Amazon is funding a new nuclear plant in Indiana

content: Amazon has signed an agreement with X-energy and American Electric Power (AEP) to fund the building of a new nuclear energy facility in Indiana. The proposed plant, which would replace the now defunct coal-fueled Breed Generating Station in Fairbanks, Sullivan County, aims to provide up to 960 megawatts of carbon-free energy for both the regional power grid and Amazon’s data centers. No timeline for construction or operation has been announced for the facility, which Amazon says “could” create 1,000 construction jobs and 100 permanent roles. The facility in Indiana is targeting to build 12 Xe-100 SMR’s, an advanced (but unproven) reactor that’s still undergoing development and licensing. These reactors can be cooled using either air, water, or a hybrid solution of both, which Amazon says should allow them to be deployed in water-constrained regions without impacting water demand in local communities. Indiana also happens to be home to a famously expensive and uncompleted energy project called the Marble Hill Nuclear Power Plant. It was abandoned half-finished in 1983 after $2.5 billion had already been sunk into it, and has been under continued demolition since 2008. Terms for Amazon’s agreement in Fairbanks haven’t been disclosed, so we can’t compare the cost between the facilities. This marks the second nuclear energy project that Amazon and X-energy are collaborating on, with the collective goal of working with regional utilities to deploy more than 5 gigawatts of new nuclear capacity in the US by 2039. In October last year, Amazon shared an early preview of its first planned nuclear plant, the Cascade Advanced Energy Facility in Washington. That project is similarly set to build 12 advanced reactors and create local jobs, but construction isn’t expected to start until the end of this decade. Amazon is one of several tech companies, including Meta, Microsoft, and Google, that are exploring their own nuclear energy projects to power AI data centers. Investing in energy grid infrastructure was also one of the commitments that Amazon outlined in a lengthy blog post earlier this month that aimed to sway some of the growing negativity around data center projects, though it’ll be many years before anyone — including Amazon — can reap the benefits of these new facilities.
chineseTitle: 亚马逊正在资助印第安纳州一座新核电站
chineseSummary: 亚马逊已与 X-energy 和美国电力公司 (AEP) 签署协议，资助在印第安纳州建设一座新核能设施。拟议的工厂将取代沙利文县费尔班克斯现已废弃的燃煤品种发电站，旨在为该地区提供高达 960 兆瓦的无碳能源[...]
chineseContent: 亚马逊已与 X-energy 和美国电力公司 (AEP) 签署协议，资助在印第安纳州建设一座新核能设施。拟议的工厂将取代沙利文县费尔班克斯现已废弃的燃煤品种发电站，旨在为地区电网和亚马逊数据中心提供高达 960 兆瓦的无碳能源。该设施的建设或运营时间表尚未公布，亚马逊称该设施“可以”创造 1,000 个建筑工作岗位和 100 个永久性职位。印第安纳州的工厂目标是建造 12 座 Xe-100 SMR，这是一种先进（但未经证实）的反应堆，仍在开发和许可中。这些反应堆可以使用空气、水或两者的混合解决方案进行冷却，亚马逊表示，这应该允许它们部署在缺水地区，而不会影响当地社区的用水需求。印第安纳州也恰好是一个著名的昂贵且未完成的能源项目的所在地，称为大理石山核电站。 1983 年，该项目投入了 25 亿美元，半成品就被废弃了，自 2008 年以来一直在持续拆除。亚马逊在费尔班克斯的协议条款尚未披露，因此我们无法比较这些设施之间的成本。这标志着亚马逊和 X-energy 合作的第二个核能项目，共同目标是与地区公用事业公司合作，到 2039 年在美国部署超过 5 吉瓦的新核电容量。去年 10 月，亚马逊分享了其第一座计划核电站——华盛顿 Cascade 先进能源设施的早期预览。该项目同样旨在建造 12 座先进反应堆并创造当地就业机会，但预计施工要到 2020 年才会开始。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
